solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Spring and fall

definitions.meaning: to spring lightly along is to step nimbly, a light skipping movement
to stumble over something and tumble down

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses belong to one verb: a light skipping step, and a stumble that sends you over.

clue.text: Details pin crudely coated with metal

indicators.note: done crudely, the letters of the two words are roughly knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Some fine points about a pin, roughly plated in metal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something treated this way has been given a layer of the precious grey-white metal Pt.

clue.text: Period out of power seen as disappointment

indicators.note: the power letter is taken out of the word for a period of time

parts.note: a spell is a period of time
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: A stretch spent out of office is viewed as a letdown for a politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A sell is an informal word for a letdown or a hoax that leaves one feeling let down.

clue.text: Company's impact suspending current where rivers meet

parts.note: CO is the usual abbreviation for company

indicators.note: suspending here means stopping or removing, so the current symbol is dropped

parts.note: impact or effect on others is influence
I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: A firm's effect is put on hold, perhaps at a meeting point of waterways.
explanation.definitionFit: A confluence is the junction where two streams or watercourses flow together.

clue.text: Musical performance has one in support

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits underneath, so it comes after

parts.note: a gig is a live music performance
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A performance has one person holding things up from beneath.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigi is the Lerner and Loewe stage and screen musical about a Parisian girl.

clue.text: Criticise anthropomorphism in marketing?

definitions.meaning: to make critical remarks about, censure
read playfully as ..., an animated advertisement in which products or animals act like people

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition is whimsical, signalled by the question mark: split the word into an animated advert, the kind where cartoon creatures and products speak like humans.
explanation.definitionFit: To animadvert on something is a formal way of passing critical comment upon it.

clue.text: Souvenir copy with page missing (unfinished)

indicators.note: left unfinished, the word loses its final letter
with the page abbreviation missing, that letter is dropped from the word for a copy

parts.note: a replica is a copy

explanation.surface: A souvenir reproduction lacks a page and was never completed.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is an object kept from the past as a memento of a person or event.

clue.text: Meeting producing grounds identifying no grim offence, possibly

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A gathering that sees no grim offence, so no grounds for action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grounds' looks legal, suggesting grounds for a case, but it means the dregs left in the pot after brewing.
explanation.definitionFit: A coffee morning is a social gathering, often for charity, where a brew made from ground beans is served.

clue.text: It summons up a career linked to energy

parts.note: E is the physics symbol for energy
a vocation is a calling or career

explanation.surface: A job description linked to the power supply calls something up.
explanation.definitionFit: An evocation is the act of calling a memory, feeling or spirit to mind.

clue.text: Entertainment centre means upmarket changes

indicators.note: the letters of the two words undergo changes into a new order

explanation.surface: A leisure venue going upmarket means alterations.
explanation.definitionFit: An amusement park is a place of rides and attractions, a centre for fun.

clue.text: Contemptible rudeness about university — suitable to require recall?

indicators.note: to recall is to call back, so the whole assembly is read backwards
the word for rudeness goes about the other pieces

parts.note: lip is cheeky, rude talk
fit means suitable

explanation.surface: A shameful bit of cheek about a university, so fit to be withdrawn.
explanation.definitionFit: Pitiful can mean deserving scorn, wretchedly inadequate, as in a feeble effort.

clue.text: Part of spectrum is adopted by family art movement

indicators.note: taken into the family, so the other pieces sit inside it

parts.note: FAM is a short informal form of family
UV, ultraviolet, is a band of the electromagnetic spectrum
taken as written

explanation.surface: A band of the colour range is taken up by a household art movement.
explanation.definitionFit: Fauvism was the early twentieth-century painting style of Matisse and Derain, known for wild colour.

clue.text: Wilder stuff playing out in nebulous adverts

indicators.note: the letters play out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Wilder material appearing in vague advertisements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wilder' looks like a comparative of wild, but it is the film director Billy Wilder.
explanation.definitionFit: Sunset Boulevard is the 1950 film noir directed by Billy Wilder, so it is part of his body of work.

clue.text: Pale, engaging in drinking for river expedition

indicators.note: the pale word engages in, goes into, the drinking word

parts.note: supping is drinking
wan means pale

explanation.surface: Looking pale from drinking, someone sets off on a trip along the water.
explanation.walkthrough: Swan upping is the annual census of mute swans on the River Thames, when birds are caught, marked and released.
explanation.definitionFit: The ceremony is carried out by boat over several days along the Thames, a river trip.

clue.text: Key approach capable of generating notability?

indicators.note: the letters can be rearranged to generate another word

explanation.surface: A method that could make someone famous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' suggests importance, but it is the musical sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Bitonality is the use of two musical keys at once, a compositional approach.

clue.text: Youngster, one to be more idle, getting reduced amount of money

parts.note: A means one

indicators.note: reduced means shortened, so the phrase loses its final letter

parts.note: to do less is to be more idle
a cent is a small amount of money

explanation.surface: A young person, one to be lazier, gets a smaller allowance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reduced' drops the last letter of DO LESS to give DOLES.
explanation.definitionFit: An adolescent is a teenager, someone between childhood and adulthood.

clue.text: No opening in exam success for idiot

indicators.note: with no opening, the first letter is dropped

parts.note: a pass is success in an exam

explanation.surface: Without a start in exam success, someone is a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: Ass is a common insult for a stupid person.

clue.text: Egg seen around at end of risible performance

indicators.note: the egg word goes around the little word at

parts.note: egg was old military slang for a bomb or mine

indicators.note: the end of the word is its last letter

explanation.surface: An egg is spotted near the end of a laughable show.
explanation.definitionFit: A matinee is an afternoon showing of a play or film.

clue.text: Some person, evidently

indicators.note: some of the letters of the following words supply the answer

explanation.surface: Someone, quite clearly.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun one stands for any person, as in 'one should know better'.

clue.text: Inadequate funding for European articles ready for service?

parts.note: UN is a French indefinite article
DER is a German definite article
a priest in vestment, the robes, is ready to take a church service

explanation.surface: A lack of money for continental goods that are ready to use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service' looks commercial but means a church service.
explanation.definitionFit: Underinvestment is putting in too little capital, a shortfall of money.

clue.text: Power of arms not initially taking sides

indicators.note: the first letter of the word is not included

parts.note: martial means relating to war or arms

explanation.surface: Military might at first shows no bias.
explanation.definitionFit: To be partial is to favour one side, to be biased.

clue.text: Travel across river first

indicators.note: the river letter is moved to the front

parts.note: over means across

explanation.surface: Journey over a river first.
explanation.definitionFit: To rove is to wander about, to journey without a fixed route.

clue.text: Account penned by fellow with hat that's floppy

indicators.note: penned in, the account abbreviation is enclosed by the other pieces

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat

explanation.surface: A report written by a man in a hat that droops.
explanation.definitionFit: Flaccid means limp and soft, lacking firmness.

clue.text: Limitation to first stronghold

indicators.note: a limitation cuts the word short, so its last letter is lost

parts.note: forth means onward, to the front

explanation.surface: A limit to the first fortress.
explanation.definitionFit: A fort is a fortified military building.

clue.text: Be the end of party turning up second

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up reads the word from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second

explanation.surface: The party's end comes as a second turns up.
explanation.definitionFit: To doom is to condemn to ruin, to finish off.

clue.text: One shows the way to a raving lunatic

indicators.note: lunatic suggests letters behaving crazily into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone guides a madman along.
explanation.definitionFit: A navigator is the person who directs the route of a ship, aircraft or car.

clue.text: Knowledge? More of the same needed for martial art

parts.note: ken means knowledge or understanding
DO is short for ditto, the same again

explanation.surface: Knowing something, then repeating it, is required for combat training.
explanation.definitionFit: Kendo is Japanese fencing with bamboo swords.
